newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's Daewoo Motor June sales down 2.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's Daewoo Motor June sales down 2.5 pct.

text.p: Daewoo Motor Co Ltd, an unlisted unit of South Korea's Daewoo Group, said on Tuesday its vehicles sales in June fell 2.5 percent to 85,542 units from 87,754 units a year earlier.
A Daewoo statement said exports dropped 10.5 percent to 54,063 units in the month from 60,379 units a year before.
A Daewoo statement said domestic sales rose 15 percent to 31,479 units from 27,375 units a year ago.
"The rise in domestic sales was due largely to the debut of new model cars, including the Leganza and Nubira," it said.
Sales of Leganza mid-sized sedans, which began selling in April, totalled 10,024 units in June and smaller Nubira cars, which rolled out from February, amounted to 8,025 units.
"Our share in the domestic passenger car market rose to 35.1 percent in June from 26.8 percent thanks to the new models," said a Daewoo official.
He said exports were hampered by a lack of cargo ships.
"In addition, our new models have yet to replace old ones," the official said.
Daewoo's vehicle sales in the first half of this year totalled 461,977 units, compared with 382,664 units a year ago.
